gh pr create \
  --title "feat(mas): add geo-tiered CTA mode toggle with hydrate-level swap" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Adds `ctaMode` settings flag (`default` | `buy-only` | `trial-only`) per geo/surface to enable sitewide CTA swap without modifying card fragments
- Implements hydrate-level swap logic in `web-components/hydrate.js` that suppresses the non-active CTA type (d2p or twp) at render time, with Learn More fallback for unpaired single CTAs
- Delivers `ctaMode` through the existing MAS-IO settings payload per locale — no new endpoints required

## Issue
Closes #6

## Test plan
- [ ] Server starts without errors (`npm run dev:server`)
- [ ] Client builds without errors (`npm run build --workspace=apps/experience-qa/client`)
- [ ] Manual smoke test: toggle T1 geo to `buy-only` → verify trial CTAs are suppressed across T1 pages
- [ ] Manual smoke test: toggle T1 geo to `trial-only` → verify buy CTAs are suppressed across T1 pages
- [ ] Verify dual-CTA placements hide the non-active CTA and show no visual gap
- [ ] Verify single-CTA placements falling back to Learn More when CTA type conflicts with active mode
- [ ] Verify suppressed CTAs have `aria-hidden` and `tabindex=-1` set and no event handlers attached
- [ ] Confirm no content fragments are modified — swap is runtime only via settings
EOF
)" \
  --base stage
